Storage ring bunch cleaning request. Bunch Cleaning (write-only): Each write of a value other than 0 removes the charge stored in the ring, so the next injected shot circulates alone.
Storage ring injection busy. Injection Busy (read-only): 1 while a requested shot is under way, 0 when the injector is ready for the next request.
Storage ring injection request. Injection Request (write-only): Each increase of this counter asks for one injected shot.

Storage ring stored beam current readback. Stored Beam: The charge injected shots leave captured in the ring. Stored Current (read-only): Current of the charge captured from injected shots, in milliamperes; it grows with each captured shot while the RF is On, decays shot by shot while the RF is Off, and reads 0 after bunch cleaning.

Storage ring turn-by-turn turns tracked readback. Turn-by-Turn Data: Beam position and signal sum on every turn after an injected shot. Turns Tracked Readback (read-only): Number of turns after the trigger sample the acquisitions record beam on.

Storage ring turn-by-turn turns tracked setpoint. Turn-by-Turn Data: Beam position and signal sum on every turn after an injected shot. Turns Tracked Setpoint (read-write): Number of turns after the trigger sample that every monitor's turn-by-turn acquisition records beam on (the buffer size); later samples hold the no-beam reading.

Storage ring injection septum SEK current readback (read-only): the measured peak current of the septum pulse.
Storage ring injection septum SEK current setpoint (read-write): the commanded peak current of the septum pulse. Scales the sampled current pulse.

Storage ring injection septum SEK current pulse waveform (read-only): the sampled time trace of one current pulse, 500 samples in A, refreshed about once a second. Its peak follows the current setpoint; it is flat zero while the septum is off.
Storage ring injection septum SEK on status (read-only): the septum supply is energized and pulsing. When false the sampled current pulse is a flat zero trace.
Storage ring injection septum SEN current readback (read-only): the measured peak current of the septum pulse.
Storage ring injection septum SEN current setpoint (read-write): the commanded peak current of the septum pulse.
Storage ring injection septum SEN on status (read-only): the septum supply is energized and pulsing.
Storage ring RF on readback. RF System: The RF that keeps the stored beam captured. RF On Readback (read-only): Whether the RF is Off or On.

Storage ring RF on setpoint. RF System: The RF that keeps the stored beam captured. RF On Setpoint (read-write): Switches the RF Off or On. With RF Off the ring has no closed orbit: orbit, tune and chromaticity read not a number, an injected shot is not captured and the stored beam decays shot by shot.
